```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
# Pre-draft inputs (decision 0043): the invitee list, placed by its college id.
combine <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "combine") |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(combine_position_group(pos), pos_levels))
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
status_levels <- c(
  "Draft-eligible population",
  "Linked, outside the population",
  "No college id"
)
status_key <- c(
  eligible = "Draft-eligible population",
  outside_population = "Linked, outside the population",
  unmatched = "No college id"
)
placed <- combine_funnel_status(combine, outcomes) |>
  count(position_group, funnel_status) |>
  mutate(status = factor(status_key[as.character(funnel_status)], status_levels))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(placed, aes(n, forcats::fct_rev(position_group), fill = status)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s, %s: %d invitees", position_group, status, n),
      data_id = paste(position_group, status)
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      `Draft-eligible population` = "#B45309",
      `Linked, outside the population` = "#9CA3AF",
      `No college id` = "#D1D5DB"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Which combine invitees can be placed among draft-eligible players?",
    subtitle = "Invitees by position group and where they can be placed",
    x = "Invitees",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

card_thumbnail(p, "combine-invitees-in-the-population", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-position
share_placed <- placed |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  summarise(
    invitees = sum(n),
    share = sum(n[status == "Draft-eligible population"]) / sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(position_group = reorder(position_group, share))
p_share <- ggplot(share_placed, aes(100 * share, position_group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %.0f%% in the population (%d invitees)", position_group, 100 * share, invitees),
      data_id = as.character(position_group)
    ),
    fill = "#374151",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "How much of each position group can be placed in the population?",
    subtitle = "Share of invitees placed among draft-eligible players",
    x = "Share of invitees",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_share, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```
